name: The Evil Eye
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the uncontrolled potential to harm others; those making stress rolls in the character's presence roll an extra botch die, warded off by amulets, rituals, or magic resistance.

name: Gabai
description: Minor Social Status Flaw for the community-appointed Jewish tax collector, who carries a -2 Reputation of 'Tax Collector'.

name: Karaite Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw requiring all magic to be designed with Holy Magic, forbidding divination, astrology, and summoning spirits, and barring acceptance of non-Karaite magic or healing.

name: Outsider
description: Social Status Flaw (Minor or Major) for members of distrusted groups such as Jews, Saracens, or Moors, giving a bad Reputation; required of Jewish grogs (Minor) and companions (Major).

name: Tzadik Nistar
description: Major Story Flaw: the character is one of the 36 hidden righteous on whom the world relies, destined to face a moral test with grave consequences if failed.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: Story Flaw gained when a Merkavah student botches the Disciplined roll, alerting Infernal spirits to his search.

name: Weak-Willed
description: Flaw that all golems suffer, representing their trusting nature.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Flaw taken by the Ba'al Shem companion template, troubled by faeries of the road.

name: Meddler
description: Minor Flaw taken by the shadchan grog template.

name: Clumsy
description: Flaw taken by the shadchan grog template.

name: Carefree
description: Personality Flaw taken by the Ba'al Shem companion template.

name: Driven
description: Major Flaw taken by the kabbalist template, driven to obtain kabbalistic secrets.

name: Feud
description: Flaw taken by the kabbalist template, feuding with Karaite kabbalists.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw taken by the kabbalist companion template.

name: Enemies
description: Flaw taken by the Radhanite merchant template, with Christian merchants as enemies.

name: Greedy
description: Minor Flaw taken by the Radhanite merchant template.

name: Obese
description: Flaw taken by the Radhanite merchant template.

name: Tragedy of Hubris
description: Consequence suffered by kabbalists who overreach, e.g. attempting to create a second golem for a community already protected; also triggers golem madness rolls.

name: Holy Magic
description: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue and Ability by which Karaite magi design all their magic in accordance with God's will instead of Magic Theory.

name: Kabbalist
description: Free Mythic Companion Virtue representing the calling of a kabbalist.

name: Educated
description: Virtue (here Educated (Hebrew)) required of kabbalists and taken by Jewish templates.

name: Shadchan
description: Social Status Virtue of the Jewish marriage broker.

name: Sofer
description: Social Status Virtue of the Jewish scribe.

name: Rabbi
description: Social Status Virtue taken by the kabbalist template, who must tend to his community's earthly concerns.

name: Merchant
description: Social Status Virtue taken by the Radhanite merchant template; also an Ability.

name: Ceremony
description: Virtue and Ability allowing a leader to combine the efforts of several practitioners, granting a Ceremony bonus when awakening golems or seeking True Names.

name: Adjuration
description: Holy Method favored by the Ba'al Shem, used in the Merkavah Total.

name: Blessing
description: Holy Method favored by the Ba'al Shem.

name: Invocation
description: Holy Method; Kabbalah is its Jewish form.

name: Meditation
description: Divine Method; Gematria is its Jewish form, and Dream Interpretation can act as a form of it.

name: Purity
description: Holy Method; Merkavah is its Jewish form.

name: Understanding
description: Holy Power used by kabbalists, contributing to the Shinnui Shem aging bonus.

name: Wonders
description: Holy Power used in the Awaken Golem and Empower Golem totals.

name: Intervention
description: Holy Power whose guideline is used in the example golem power.

name: Transcendence
description: Holy Method favored by the Karaites.

name: Philosophic Magic
description: Virtue taken by the kabbalist companion template.

name: Puissant Kabbalah
description: Virtue granting a bonus to Kabbalah, taken by the kabbalist template.

name: Puissant Scribe
description: Virtue taken by the sofer template.

name: Puissant Merchant
description: Virtue taken by the Radhanite merchant template.

name: Clear Thinker
description: Virtue taken by the shadchan and kabbalist templates.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue taken by the kabbalist template.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue taken by the kabbalist (Kabbalists) and Radhanite merchant templates.

name: Gossip
description: Virtue taken by the sofer template, who is known as a local gossip.

name: Magical Air
description: Taken by the Ba'al Shem companion template.

name: Wealthy
description: Virtue taken by the Radhanite merchant template.

name: Protection
description: Virtue taken by the Radhanite merchant, protected by the Muqta' of Baghdad.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue taken by the Radhanite merchant template.

name: Unaging
description: Virtue possessed by all golems.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue possessed by all golems.

name: Craft Amulets
description: Supernatural Ability used by the Ba'al Shem with Holy Methods and Powers to create Minor and Major amulets of Touch range and Worn duration.

name: Dream Interpretation
description: Supernatural Ability used either as a form of Meditation or as direct divination through interpreting dreams.

name: Gematria
description: Supernatural Ability, the Jewish form of the Meditation Divine Method; also a divination method revealing hidden numeric meanings in the Torah and the basis of Shinnui Shem.

name: Kabbalah
description: Supernatural Ability, the Jewish form of the Invocation Divine Method, and the mystical understanding of creation used to make golems; also the Jewish occult tradition as a whole.

name: Merkavah
description: Supernatural Ability, the Jewish form of the Purity Divine Method, and the study of the names of angels, demons and other creatures to learn their True Names.

name: Judaic Lore
description: Knowledge of Jewish cultural practice such as poetry, folklore, and songs.

name: Rabbinical Law
description: Academic Ability, the Jewish version of Civil & Canon Law, drawing on the Talmud, Oral Torah and responsa of the Geonim.

name: Theology: Judaism
description: Academic Ability, the Jewish equivalent of Christian Theology, based on the Torah, Nevi'im and Ketuvim.

name: Civil & Canon Law
description: Academic Ability of which Rabbinical Law is the Jewish version.

name: Premonitions
description: Ability that grants a bonus to Dream Interpretation divination rolls.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Lore Ability studied by some members of the Circle of the Unique Cherub and required of kabbalists.

name: Hebrew
description: Language Ability required of kabbalists and possessed by all golems.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic Ability which Karaite magi replace with Holy Magic.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability required of kabbalists.

name: Penetration
description: Ability governing how effects overcome resistance; applies to amulets and golem powers.

name: Aramaic
description: Language Ability of the sofer and kabbalist templates.

name: Percamenarius
description: Craft ability of the sofer, specialized in Sefer Torah.

name: Illumination
description: Ability of the sofer, specialized in Sefer Torah.

name: Profession: Shadchan
description: Profession ability of the Jewish marriage broker.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique; Dream Interpretation Ease Factors equal the level of an equivalent Momentary Intellego spell.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form of the mind, referenced via an Intellego Mentem spell.

name: Perception of the Conflicting Motives
description: Intellego Mentem spell used as the Ease Factor (15) benchmark in the Dream Interpretation example.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Hermetic ward whose magic resistance suffices to guard against the Evil Eye.

name: Holy Methods
description: Divine abilities (e.g. Adjuration, Blessing, Invocation, Meditation, Purity) of which Jewish Abilities like Gematria, Kabbalah and Merkavah are forms.

name: Holy Powers
description: Divine powers combined with Holy Methods; golem powers are designed with their guidelines.

name: Holy Tradition
description: Category of Divine practitioner traditions such as the Ba'al Shem.

name: Holy Societates
description: Category for Hermetic lineages practicing holy magic, such as the Karaites.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Companion character type with supernatural calling, such as the kabbalist.

name: Amulet
description: Protective or aiding object crafted with Craft Amulets, Minor (for an individual, lasting days or weeks) or Major (taking seasons to create).

name: Worn
description: New duration for amulets, equivalent to Sun, lasting until the amulet is broken or removed.

name: Terafim
description: Small pottery figurines used in divination and witchcraft, giving +5 to Understanding or Cursing amulet effects.

name: Star of David
description: Symbol providing a +5 bonus to protection amulets.

name: Shinnui Shem
description: Kabbalistic rite of changing one's True Name through Gematria, severing arcane connections and granting a bonus to Aging Rolls.

name: True Name
description: A being's hidden name; kabbalists learn angels' and others' True Names via Merkavah for use as Holy Connections, and golems possess one fixed at creation.

name: Holy Connection
description: Connection akin to an arcane connection; a learned True Name serves as one and grants +5 Penetration.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target used by amulets and Dream Interpretation; severed by Shinnui Shem.

name: Sefirot
description: The ten emanations described in the Sefer Yetzirah, the knowable aspects of creation, studied in Kabbalah from Malchut to Keter.

name: The Tree of Life
description: The Etz Chayim, visual arrangement of the ten Sefirot linked by 22 pathways aligned to the Hebrew letters.

name: Keter
description: Sefirah meaning 'Crown', level 10 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 10.

name: Chochmah
description: Sefirah meaning 'Wisdom', level 9 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 9.

name: Binah
description: Sefirah meaning 'Insight', level 8 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 8.

name: Chessed
description: Sefirah meaning 'Love', level 7 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 7.

name: Gevurah
description: Sefirah meaning 'Power', level 6 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 6.

name: Tiferet
description: Sefirah meaning 'Beauty', level 5 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 5.

name: Netzach
description: Sefirah meaning 'Endurance', level 4 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 4.

name: Hod
description: Sefirah meaning 'Splendor', level 3 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 3.

name: Yesod
description: Sefirah meaning 'Foundation', level 2 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 2.

name: Malchut
description: Sefirah meaning 'Kingdom', level 1 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 1.

name: Ein Sof
description: The infinite and unknowable counterpart to the Sefirot; hubristic kabbalists who strive for it risk temptation.

name: Kabbalah Shimmush
description: Practical kabbalah, the relatively new pragmatic, ritualistic application of the forces of creation.

name: Jewish Mysticism
description: Jewish occult tradition encompassing Gematria, Kabbalah, golems and Merkavah.

name: Chariot Mysteries
description: Ancient mystical practice inspired by Ezekiel's vision of the divine chariot, seeking communion with angels.

name: Emet
description: Word meaning 'truth' written on a golem's forehead; erasing the aleph makes it 'met' (death) and returns the golem to clay.

name: Eruv
description: Boundary temporarily set up to define the community a golem protects.

name: Mitzvah
description: Religious commandment; commanding a golem to transgress one risks madness.

name: Divine Might
description: A golem's Might Score, accumulated during awakening and spent to use its powers.

name: Dominion Aura
description: Divine aura adding a bonus to amulet crafting, golem creation and Merkavah totals.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance of 0 or more, including the Aegis of the Hearth, which protects against the Evil Eye.

name: Aging Roll
description: Roll against aging to which Shinnui Shem grants a bonus.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Hermetic rituals to prolong life; Karaites must design them with Holy Magic, and they don't stack with Shinnui Shem.

name: Initiation
description: Process by which Ba'al Shem and kabbalist communities grant members additional Holy Methods and Powers.

name: Goetic Arts
description: Infernal summoning arts (Summoning, Commanding, Binding) used by the Ba'al Ov.

name: Natural Philosophy
description: Arts open to Jewish scholars distrustful of magic.

name: Elemental Magic
description: Magical tradition to which Jewish scholars are drawn, especially in Muslim Spain or the East.

name: Learned Magician
description: Hedge magic tradition some Jewish scholars adopt.

name: Ba'al Shem
description: Jewish itinerant folk magicians, 'masters of the Divine name', who craft amulets and deliver blessings for pay; favored Abilities Adjuration, Blessing, Craft Amulets and Invocation.

name: Karaites
description: Strict scriptural Jewish sect; Gifted Karaites form a small lineage in House Ex Miscellanea practicing Holy Magic.

name: Kabbalists
description: Jewish mystics drawing on the Sefer Yetzirah and Sefirot, often in large urban Jewish communities working with Ceremony.

name: Circle of the Unique Cherub
description: Small invitation-only school of no more than a dozen Jewish mystics in Provence and the Rhine, using the Sefer Yetzirah; they have created three golems.

name: Ba'al Ov
description: Jewish necromantic summoners who compel spirits into objects and corpses using Goetic Arts.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House containing a Karaite lineage.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order which Gifted Karaites can join if their magic is wholly based on God's will.

name: Radhanites
description: Jewish merchants; the Radhanite merchant template serves the Muqta' of Baghdad.

name: Tzadikim Nistarim
description: The 36 hidden righteous upon whom the continuation of the world relies.

name: Geonim
description: Jewish authorities whose responsa are a major source of Rabbinical Law.

name: Jews
description: The Jewish people, distrusted outsiders in Europe living in communities or Jewish quarters.

name: Saracens
description: Group readily identified and distrusted by Europeans.

name: Moors
description: Group readily identified and distrusted by Europeans.

name: Shadchan
description: Jewish marriage broker grog template who travels between communities finding matches.

name: Sofer
description: Jewish scribe grog template, here also tax collector and gossip.

name: Ba'al Shem (companion)
description: Companion template of an itinerant Ba'al Shem tinker working wonders around Bremen.

name: Kabbalist (companion)
description: Mythic Companion template, a rabbi and kabbalist.

name: Radhanite Merchant
description: Wealthy Jewish merchant companion template serving a richer master.

name: Grog
description: Background character type; Jewish grogs must take Outsider (Minor).

name: Golem
description: Clay figure brought to life by Divine energies through Kabbalah, usually in human form as protector of a community; has Divine Might and may be empowered, go mad, or be destroyed.

name: Angel of Death
description: Angel who carries men away at death; Shinnui Shem hides a man from him by changing his name.

name: Angels
description: Divine beings whose True Names Ba'al Shem invoke and Merkavah practitioners seek.

name: Demons
description: Infernal beings whose True Names can be learned via Merkavah.

name: Faeries
description: Creatures of the Faerie realm; faeries of the road plague the Ba'al Shem template.

name: Ghosts
description: Spirits of the dead which Karaites may not summon; some dream interpreters sleep in graveyards for their aid.

name: Aron
description: A Ba'al Shem who interprets Elizabeth's dreams in an example.

name: Elizabeth
description: Woman who consults Ba'al Shem Aron about her secretive husband.

name: Moshe ben Isaac
description: Example kabbalist who creates the golem Isaac to protect his community from a corrupt tax collector.

name: Isaac (golem)
description: Golem created by Moshe ben Isaac with Divine Might 23, empowered to instill Divine anxiety in a greedy tax collector.

name: Muqta' of Baghdad
description: Powerful patron protecting the Radhanite merchant.

name: David
description: Biblical figure who received dreams from God.

name: Joseph
description: Biblical figure who received dreams from God.

name: Ezekiel
description: Prophet whose vision of the divine chariot inspired Merkavah.

name: Isaiah
description: Prophet whose enthronement visions inspired Merkavah.

name: Provence
description: Region where the Circle of the Unique Cherub is based.

name: Rhine
description: Region where the Circle of the Unique Cherub is based.

name: Jerusalem
description: City where Karaite magi are most likely found.

name: Iberia
description: Region where Kabbalah arose and where outsider cultures are common; Muslim Iberia hosts Karaite magi.

name: Holy Land
description: Region where outsider cultures are more common.

name: Bremen
description: Area around which the Ba'al Shem template travels.

name: York
description: City whose Jews know the sofer as tax collector and gossip.

name: Baghdad
description: City of the Muqta' who protects the Radhanite merchant.

name: Southern France
description: Region where Kabbalah arose in the twelfth century.

name: Sefer Yetzirah
description: Foundational kabbalistic text describing creation from numbers, writing and speech, and the ten Sefirot.

name: Torah
description: The direct written word of God; primary source for Gematria and Jewish theology.

name: Oral Torah
description: Major source of Rabbinical Law.

name: Talmud
description: Major source of Rabbinical Law.

name: Tanakh
description: Hebrew Bible used in Shinnui Shem.

name: Nevi'im
description: Source for Jewish theology.

name: Ketuvim
description: Source for Jewish theology.

name: Book of Jeremiah
description: Biblical book telling Jews to seek the well-being of where they live, justifying golem protectors.

name: Divine
description: Realm source of Jewish mystical power, manifest as the Dominion.

name: Infernal
description: Realm that may claim souls or alert its spirits to careless Merkavah students.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm whose creatures' names Merkavah studies.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm whose creatures' names Merkavah studies.
